column1: # *** THE MONTEVIDEO DISPENSATION REGISTER, READ BY FULL TEXT. 9 October 2026 - row 194, second half. ***
# Arquidiocesis de Montevideo, Marriage Dispensation Records 1856-1932 and 1932-1935.
# *** FIRST, A CORRECTION TO YESTERDAY'S REASON FOR COMING HERE. *** Row 194 said dispensations are
# worth opening because "the pre-marriage investigation routinely gives a Spanish groom's PARENTS".
# *** THAT IS TRUE OF THE EXPEDIENTE AND NOT OF THIS BOOK. *** This is the DISPENSATION REGISTER - a
# summary ledger in which the Vicar General records, in one sentence each, whom he dispensed and
# from what. *** NOT ONE OF THESE NINE ENTRIES NAMES A PARENT. *** The expedientes are a different
# series. Two record classes were conflated, and the distinction is the useful part.
# *** AND WHAT IT GIVES INSTEAD IS BETTER FOR THE QUESTION THIS ARCHIVE ACTUALLY HAS. *** A
# CONSANGUINITY dispensation is a statement about SHARED ANCESTRY: the Church computed the degree
# before it would dispense. *** A second-degree equal lateral line is FIRST COUSINS. A third degree
# is second cousins. "With attingency to the second" means the two are related by two different
# paths at once. *** That constrains a pedigree even when no parent is named.

column2: Don Luis P. Marquez and *** Dona MERCEDES LERENA ***, feligresa de la *** CATEDRAL ***
column3: Dispensed *** two conciliar banns *** - a routine dispensation of notice, not of kinship
column4: A Lerena woman in the Montevideo CATHEDRAL parish, which is the trunk this archive works. *** New to this register. ***

column2: Don *** SERAPIO FERNANDEZ (hijo) *** and *** Dona ANTONINA LERENA ***, feligresa de *** TRINIDAD ***
column3: *** SECOND GRADE of consanguinity by the EQUAL lateral line ***
column4: *** FIRST COUSINS. *** And the groom is a *** FERNANDEZ *** - the surname of Sancho Llerena's wife Maria Fernandez and of Avelino Lerena Fernandez. *** New to this register. ***

column1: *** 26 June 1885 - THE SAME DAY ***
column2: Don *** MAXIMO PELAEZ *** and *** Dona MARIA LERENA ***, feligresa de *** TRINIDAD ***
column3: *** THIRD GRADE of consanguinity WITH ATTINGENCY TO THE SECOND, by the UNEQUAL lateral line ***
column4: *** TWO LERENA WOMEN OF TRINIDAD DISPENSED IN ONE SITTING ***, one to a Fernandez and one to a *** PELAEZ ***. "With attingency to the second" means two separate blood paths at once. *** New to this register. ***

column2: Don *** JUAN LERENA *** and *** Dona EDUVIGES PELAEZ ***, feligresa de *** MERCEDES ***
column3: *** SECOND GRADE equal lateral AND THIRD GRADE equal lateral, both accumulated *** - dispensed *** de oficio ***, that is free, which the register reserves for the poor
column4: *** FIRST COUSINS AND SECOND COUSINS AT ONCE. *** And a THIRD Lerena-Pelaez union. *** This archive already holds BERNABE LERENA married to CASIMIRA PELAEZ at Trinidad *** - see data/lerena-pelaez-trinidad.tsv. *** New to this register. ***

column1: *** 1 February 1901 ***
column2: Don *** ADOLFO CORDERO *** and *** Dona ZELMIRA CARLOTA LERENA ***, feligresa de la *** METROPOLITANA ***
column3: *** THIRD GRADE with attingency to the SECOND, unequal lateral line ***
column4: *** THIS IS A WOMAN THIS ARCHIVE ALREADY HAS, AND ONCE WROTE OFF. *** Zelmira Carlota Lerena Larriera was tested on 14 September and concluded "not ours", and that conclusion was itself corrected. *** Here is her marriage, and it proves she married a blood relative *** - which is a fact about her ancestry, not merely her life.

column1: *** 10 November 1906 ***
column2: Don Guillermo [Repetto?] and *** Dona MARIA ELENA LERENA ***
column3: *** RELIGION MIXTA *** - the impediment of mixed religion
column4: *** ONE OF THE TWO PARTIES WAS NOT CATHOLIC. *** In a family this archive has only ever met in Catholic registers, that is worth knowing. *** New to this register. ***

column1: *** February 1913 ***
column2: Don *** VITALINO GREGORIO PELAEZ *** and *** Dona FLORINDA JUANA LERENA ***, feligresa de *** TRINIDAD ***
column3: *** THIRD GRADE of consanguinity by the EQUAL lateral line ***
column4: *** SECOND COUSINS, and a FOURTH Lerena-Pelaez union - the second of them explicitly at TRINIDAD. *** *** New to this register. ***

column1: *** 22 December 1919 ***
column2: Don *** EDUARDO LERENA *** and Dona Maria Mercedes Razzello, feligresa de *** LAS PIEDRAS ***
column4: A Lerena man at Las Piedras, Canelones - the department Sancho married in. *** New to this register. ***

column2: Don *** JUAN CARLOS GONZALEZ LERENA *** and Dona Concepcion Petrona Urbano, feligresa del *** CORDON ***
column4: *** FOUND 8 OCTOBER AND SET ASIDE ON THE SURNAME ORDER *** - Gonzalez from his father, Lerena from his mother, so his children would be Gonzalez. Kept here so the nine entries are one list.
